result.summary: 本文介绍了 Llama 3 系列基础模型，包括 8B、70B 和 405B 三个参数规模的多语言语言模型，原生支持多语言、编程、推理和工具使用 [S1.p3]。最大的模型是 405B 参数的稠密 Transformer，上下文窗口最高 128K tokens [S1.p3]。论文详细描述了预训练（约 15T 多语言 tokens）和后训练（SFT、拒绝采样、DPO）流程，并进行了广泛的基准评测和人类评估 [S1.p5][S1.p6]。实验表明旗舰模型在多种任务上与 GPT-4 等领先模型质量相当，较小模型在同类中表现最佳 [S1.p6]。论文还通过组合式方法将图像、视频和语音能力集成到 Llama 3 中，这些多模态模型仍在开发中，尚未广泛发布 [abstract][S2.p6]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在开发一套新的基础语言模型 Llama 3，原生支持多语言、编程、推理和工具使用，并探索通过组合式方法集成图像、视频和语音等多模态能力 [S1.p3][S2.p4]。研究动机是相信数据、规模和复杂度管理是开发高质量基础模型的三个关键杠杆 [S1.p4]。作者希望公开释放旗舰模型以推动研究社区创新，并加速负责任地迈向通用人工智能（AGI）[S1.p7]。

evidence.quote: In this paper, we present a new set of foundation models for language, called Llama 3.
We believe there are three key levers in the development of high-quality foundation models: data, scale, and managing complexity.

We hope that the open release of a flagship model will spur a wave of innovation in the research community, and accelerate a responsible path towards the development of artificial general intelligence (AGI).
We also perform experiments in which we add image, video, and speech capabilities to Llama 3 using a compositional approach.

method.text: Llama 3 采用标准的稠密 Transformer 架构，相比 Llama 2 仅有少量修改，如分组查询注意力（GQA）、128K 词表、提高 RoPE 基频等 [S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS2.p2]。预训练分为三个阶段：初始预训练、长上下文预训练和退火，使用约 15T 多语言 tokens，旗舰模型 405B 参数在 15.6T tokens 上训练 [S1.p5][S3.SS4.p1]。后训练采用监督微调（SFT）、拒绝采样（RS）和直接偏好优化（DPO）的多轮迭代流程 [S1.p5][S4.p1]。多模态能力通过组合式方法集成，包括多模态编码器预训练、视觉适配器训练和语音适配器训练等阶段 [S2.p5]。

evidence.quote: Llama 3 uses a standard, dense Transformer architecture.
We make a few small modifications compared to Llama 2
We pre-train Llama 3 on a corpus of about 15T multilingual tokens, compared to 1.8T tokens for Llama 2.
The recipe used to pre-train Llama 3 405B consists of three main stages: (1) initial pre-training, (2) long-context pre-training, and (3) annealing.
Each round of post-training involves supervised finetuning (SFT) followed by Direct Preference Optimization on examples collected either via human annotations or generated synthetically.

experiments.text: 论文在大量标准基准上评估了预训练和后训练模型，涵盖常识推理、知识、阅读理解、数学推理、长上下文、代码、对抗评估等八大类别 [S5.SS1.SSS1.p1]。还进行了广泛的人类评估，收集约 7000 个提示，覆盖六种单项能力和三种多轮能力 [S5.SS3.p2]。多模态实验在图像识别（如 MMMU、VQAv2、ChartQA、DocVQA）和视频识别（如 PerceptionTest、NExT-QA、TVQA、ActivityNet-QA）以及语音识别和翻译任务上进行了评估 [S7.SS6.p1][S7.SS7.p1][S8.SS4.p1]。

evidence.quote: These evaluations cover eight top-level categories: (1) commonsense reasoning; (2) knowledge; (3) reading comprehension; (4) math, reasoning, and problem solving; (5) long context; (6) code; (7) adversarial evaluations; and (8) aggregate evaluations.
We used this taxonomy to collect about $7,000$ prompts spanning six individual capabilities (English, reasoning, coding, Hindi, Spanish, and Portuguese), and three multiturn capabilities

We evaluate the performance of the image understanding capabilities of Llama 3 on a range of tasks spanning natural image understanding, text understanding, charts understanding and multimodal reasoning
We evaluate our video adapter for Llama 3 on three benchmarks
We evaluate the speech understanding capabilities of our speech interface for Llama 3 on three tasks: (1) automatic speech recognition, (2) speech translation, and (3) spoken question answering.

findings.text: 实验评估表明旗舰模型在多种任务上与 GPT-4 等领先模型表现相当，接近最先进水平；较小模型在同类中最佳 [S1.p6]。Llama 3 在有用性和无害性之间取得了比前代更好的平衡 [S1.p6]。多模态组合式方法在图像、视频和语音识别任务上表现与最先进水平具有竞争力 [abstract]。人类评估显示 Llama 3 405B 与 GPT-4 0125 版本大致相当，与 GPT-4o 和 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 相比互有胜负 [S5.SS3.p4]。

evidence.quote: Our experimental evaluation suggests that our flagship model performs on par with leading language models such as GPT-4 across a variety of tasks, and is close to matching the state-of-the-art.
Llama 3 also delivers a much better balance between helpfulness and harmlessness than its predecessor.
We observe this approach performs competitively with the state-of-the-art on image, video, and speech recognition tasks.
We observe that Llama 3 405B performs approximately on par with the 0125 API version of GPT-4, while achieving mixed results (some wins and some losses) compared to GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet.

limitations.text: 多模态模型仍在积极开发中，尚未准备好发布 [S1.p8][S2.p6]。人类评估可能受标注者个人偏见、背景和偏好影响，导致结果不一致或不可靠 [S5.SS3.p5]。安全测试无法保证穷尽所有风险，Llama 3 仍可能生成有害内容，尤其对非英语语言和熟练对抗性红队人员 [S5.SS4.SSS8.p1]。

evidence.quote: These models are still under active development and not yet ready for release.
These models are still under development and not yet ready for release.
human evaluations can still be influenced by personal biases, backgrounds, and preferences of human annotators, which may lead to inconsistent or unreliable results.

no testing can be guaranteed to be exhaustive in identifying every possible risk. Llama 3 may still generate harmful content due to training on various datasets, particularly for languages beyond English and when prompt engineered by skilled adversarial red teamers.
